compatibility_note: The base environment had e3nn 0.6.0, which cannot deserialize this checkpoint. Agent 19 uses the isolated e3nn 0.4.4 runtime bundled under runtime/e3nn044.

chemical_domain.systems: neutral, closed-shell molecular structures compatible with the ANI chemical domain
excluded: ions or radicals requiring charge/spin conditioning
elements other than H, C, N and O
bonding environments outside the model training domain

reference_policy: Do not report MAE or RMSE until an independently computed QM set with exact matching structures and a compatible relative or atomization-energy convention is attached.
